_about: The one source for the resume (resume.html, the PDF, mkskitka.com/resume), the CV (cv.html) and the variants (resume-<name>.html). Edit here or with npm run resume:edit, then npm run resume:build. *text* is italic. A bullet may be an object with resumeOnly (left out of the CV), only: [variants] or not: [variants].
name: Mary Kate Skitka
title: Creative Technologist

profile.resume: Creative technologist with 8 years of experience building generative and interactive media for installations, live performance and clinical environments. Most recently built PGN, a multi-room rehabilitation system that runs body and eye tracking, depth cameras and lidar through one TouchDesigner system, now installed at two sites. Earlier work includes a generative AI video system for the Nigerian Pavilion at the 2024 Venice Biennale, and four years building visualization tools for AI research. Background in cognitive brain science and computer science; teaches creative technology at NYU.
profile.cv: Creative technologist, developer and educator working in generative and interactive media: real-time visual systems for installations, live performance and clinical environments, from concept through on-site commissioning. Practice runs on two tracks, visuals and systems: generative, environment-aware content built in TouchDesigner, ComfyUI and Three.js, and the sensing, display and software architecture that ties it to a space. Teaches creative technology at NYU and performs and exhibits in New York City as rgb__tears.

teaching._about: The teaching version: npm run resume:teaching. Education and teaching come first; the NYU roles move into a Teaching Experience section.
teaching.title: Creative Technologist & Educator
teaching.profile: Educator and creative technologist with over 8 years of experience in generative and interactive media and four years of teaching at NYU, where she designed and taught the undergraduate course Immersivity Beyond the Display, ran the ITP Coding Lab as a Research Fellow, and led workshops on TouchDesigner, Stable Diffusion, Teachable Machine and p5.js. Industry work includes a multi-room interactive rehabilitation system, a generative AI video system for the Nigerian Pavilion at the 2024 Venice Biennale, and four years building visualization tools for AI research, all of which feed back into the classroom as live examples of how creative technology is practised.
